30:3: In the nearest land, and they, after their defeat, will overcome.
30:4: Within a few years. The matter belongs to Allah, before and after. And that day the believers will rejoice.
30:5: With the help of Allah. He helps whom He wills. And He is the Mighty, the Most Merciful.
30:6: It is the promise of Allah. Allah does not fail His promise, but most of the people do not know.
30:7: They know only an outer aspect of the life of this world, and of the Hereafter they are heedless.
30:8: Have they not reflected within themselves? Allah created the heavens and the earth and what is between them only with truth and for a specified term. And indeed, many of the people surely deny the meeting with their Rabb.
30:9: Have they not traveled in the earth and seen how was the end of those before them? They were mightier than these in strength, they tilled the earth and developed it more than these developed it. And their messengers came to them with clear proofs. Allah would not wrong them, but they were wronging themselves.
30:10: Then the end of those who did evil was very evil, because they denied the verses of Allah and used to ridicule them.
30:11: Allah originates creation, then repeats it, then to Him you will be returned.
30:12: On the day the Resurrection occurs, the criminals will fall into despair.
30:13: There will be no intercessors for them from among their partners, and they will deny their partners.
30:14: And on the day the Hour occurs, that day they will be separated.
30:15: As for those who believed and did righteous deeds, they will be delighted in a garden.
30:16: As for those who disbelieved and denied Our verses and the meeting of the Hereafter, they will be brought into the punishment.
30:17: So glorify Allah when you reach the evening and when you enter the morning.
30:18: And to Him belongs praise in the heavens and the earth, when you reach the evening and when you enter the noontime.
30:19: He brings out the living from the dead, and brings out the dead from the living, and revives the earth after its death. And thus you will be brought out.
30:20: And of His signs is that He created you from dust, then you became human beings spreading out.
30:21: And of His signs is that He created for you spouses from yourselves that you may find tranquility in them, and He placed between you love and mercy.
30:22: And of His signs are the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the diversity of your languages and your colors. Surely in that are indeed signs for those who know.
30:23: And of His signs is your sleep by night and your seeking of His bounty by day. Surely in that are signs for a people who hear.
30:24: And of His signs is that He shows you lightning as fear and hope, and sends down water from the sky and revives the earth with it after its death.
30:25: And of His signs is that the heaven and the earth stand by His command, then when He calls you with a single call from the earth, you immediately come forth.
30:26: And whoever is in the heavens and the earth belongs to Him; all are obedient to Him.
30:27: And He is the One Who originates creation, then repeats it, and this is easier for Him; and to Him belongs the highest example in the heavens and the earth, and He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
30:28: He set forth for you an example from your own selves: Do you have among the slaves your right hands possess partners in what We have provided you, so that you are equal with them and you fear them as you fear your own selves? Thus We explain the verses for a people who use reason.
30:29: Rather, those who wronged followed their own desires without knowledge. Then who can guide him whom Allah has led astray? And for them there are no helpers.
30:30: Turn your face toward the religion as a hanif. The fitrah of Allah upon which He created mankind. There is no change in the creation of Allah. That is the upright religion. But most of the people do not know.
30:31: Turning to Him, fear Him and establish the salah and do not be of the mushriks.
30:32: Of those who divided their religion and became sects; each group rejoicing in what is with them.
30:33: And when harm touches people, they call upon their Rabb, turning to Him; then when He makes them taste a mercy from Himself, immediately a group of them associate partners with their Rabb.
30:34: So that they may be ungrateful for what We have given them. So enjoy yourselves; soon you will know.
30:35: Or have We sent down to them an authority concerning their associating partners, so that they were associating partners with it?
30:36: And when We make people taste a mercy, they rejoice in it; and if an evil strikes them because of what their hands have sent forth, then behold, they despair.
30:37: Have they not seen that Allah extends the provision for whom He wills and restricts it? Surely in that are signs for a people who believe.
30:38: So give the relative his right, and to the poor and the traveler. That is better for those who desire the face of Allah. And it is they who are the successful.
30:39: And whatever you give in usury so that it may increase within people's wealth does not increase with Allah; but whatever you give in zakat desiring the face of Allah, it is they who will have manifold increase.
30:40: Allah is the One Who created you, then provided for you, then causes you to die, then gives you life. Is there any among your partners that does anything of that? He is glorified and exalted above what they associate.
30:41: Corruption has appeared on land and sea because of what people's hands have earned, so that He may make them taste a part of what they have done, that perhaps they may return.
30:42: Say: Travel in the earth and see how was the end of those before. Most of them were mushriks.
30:43: Turn your face toward the upright religion before there comes a day from Allah that cannot be averted. On that day people will be separated.
30:44: Whoever disbelieves, his disbelief is against himself; and whoever does righteous deeds, they are preparing for themselves.
30:45: So that He may reward those who believe and do righteous deeds out of His bounty. Surely He does not like the disbelievers.
30:46: And of His signs is that He sends the winds as glad tidings, so that He may make you taste of His mercy, and that the ships may run by His command, and that you may seek of His bounty, and perhaps you may give thanks.
30:47: And certainly We sent before you messengers to their people. They came to them with clear proofs. Then We took retribution from the criminals. And it was a duty upon Us to help the believers.
30:48: Allah is the One Who sends the winds, so they raise a cloud, then He spreads it in the sky as He wills and makes it into fragments, then you see the rain emerging from within it. Then when He causes it to fall upon whom He wills of His servants, behold, they rejoice.
30:49: And they, before it was sent down upon them, were despairing.
30:50: So look at the effects of Allah's mercy, how He gives life to the earth after its death. Indeed, this is surely the One who gives life to the dead, and He is capable of all things.
30:51: And if We were to send a wind and they saw it turned yellow, thereafter they would surely be ungrateful.
30:52: Indeed, you cannot make the dead hear, nor can you make the deaf hear the call when they turn their backs and go away.
30:53: You are not a guide of the blind from their misguidance; you only make hear those who believe in Our verses, and they are Muslims.
30:54: Allah, it is He who created you from weakness, then made strength after weakness, then gave weakness and old age after strength.
30:55: On the day the Hour strikes, the criminals swear that they did not remain other than an hour; thus were they turned away.
30:56: Those who were given knowledge and faith say: "By oath, you remained in Allah's Book until the day of resurrection. So this is the day of resurrection, but you did not know."
30:57: On that day, their excuses do not benefit those who did wrong, nor is making amends asked of them.
30:58: And by oath, We have given of every example for mankind in this Quran; and if you bring them a verse, those who disbelieve surely say: You are only upon falsehood.
30:59: Thus Allah seals the hearts of those who do not know.
30:60: So be patient; indeed, the promise of Allah is truth, and let not those who do not believe with certainty hold you lightly.
